name: Use design tokens instead of ad-hoc style values
statement: Use the central design-token scale for spacing, color, radius, typography, and shared geometry; do not introduce raw pixel values, local colors, or one-off badge dimensions when a token covers the intent.
rationale: Token use preserves visual kinship between Agent Studio and Quality Studio, makes themes consistent, and prevents small local choices from becoming an unmaintainable parallel design system.

history.change: Initial rule covering the operator-observed ad-hoc styling defect class.
